== Walkthrough ==
=== Destroy the Inquest Excavators ===
When the meta starts, three Inquest Excavators will appear in the North, East, and South of [[Cloister of Stars]].
* All three excavators must be destroyed '''at the same time''' to progress the meta event.
* In order to damage the excavators, players must be standing in the rotating blue field, indicated by arrow markers because the excavators are {{effect|Phase-Shifted (bounty)}}.
* Periodically, the excavator will become [[invulnerable]]:
** At 75%, the excavator becomes {{effect|Shielded (Inquest Excavator)}}, several [[Mark IX Centurion Golem]]s and [[SERV]]s will protect the Excavator. When they are defeated, the excavator becomes vulnerable again.
** At 50%, the excavator becomes {{effect|Shielded (Inquest Excavator 2)}}, a [[defiance bar]] must be broken with [[crowd control]] effects. When the bar is broken, the excavator becomes vulnerable again, but will also gain additional abilities, including a pulsing shockwave, a tornado effect, and [[Magneton Destabilizer]]s.
** At 25%, the excavator becomes {{effect|Shielded (Inquest Excavator)}} again, [[Champion Mark IX Centurion Golem]] will spawn to protect the excavator. When the golem is defeated, the excavator becomes vulnerable again and can finally be destroyed.
* When an excavator is destroyed, a 30 second timer will begin. The other two excavators must be destroyed within this time limit. Otherwise, it will repair itself.

=== Gwyllian, Seneschal of the Forest ===
{{main|Gwyllian, Seneschal of the Forest}}
After destroying all three excavators, you will have 20 minutes to defeat [[Gwyllian, Seneschal of the Forest]] at the center of {{poi|Consecrated Piazza}}.

Gwyllian has two key mechanics:
* '''Bunny tranformation and orb collection''' — Occurs at 82/57/32/12% health
** Random players will be inflicted with {{effect|Something Feels Funny...}}.
** Upon expiry, those players will get the {{effect|You've been turned into a bunny!}} effect and transform into a bunny.
** Bunnies must jump to collect floating orbs in the air.
** Once enough orbs are collected, the boss will receive a [[defiance bar]] that must be broken to continue the fight.
* '''Dispel illusions with crowd control''' — Occurs at 75/25% health
** Gwyllian raises the boss arena and summons mini [[Gwyldell]] illusions on it and the surrounding floating islands.
** Most of these illusions are distractions and killing them will have no effect.
** The only illusions that need to be dealt with are those with [[defiance bar]]s. However, they '''should be CC'd and NOT killed'''.
** Progress toward the fight is only awarded for successfully breaking a defiance bar. None is awarded for killing them.
** One reliable way to handle this mechanic is using the [[Warclaw]] mount:
*** {{skill icon|Chain Pull (PvE)}} — 150 defiance
*** {{skill icon|Lance (PvE)}} — 125 defiance

=== 50% Inquest Phase ===
When Gwyllian reaches 50% health, three [[champion]] Inquest will spawn at the site of each destroyed excavator from Phase 1:
* North: [[Champion Biomancer Plezzi]]
* East: [[Champion Golemancer Graxx]]
* South: [[Champion Electromancer Dribb]]
These champion enemies '''must be defeated at the same time'''. Similarly to before, defeating one champion enemy will start a 30 second timer. The other two bosses must be defeated in this window, or else they will revive.

=== Final Phase and Loot ===
After defeating the Inquest, the fight resumes with no new mechanics.

At 25% health, Gwyllian raises the platform once more and the illusion event repeats.

After defeating Gwyllian, a [[Magnificent Chest (Castora)|Magnificent Chest]] (auto-loot) will appear under the boss arena as it lowers to the ground. Once it reaches the bottom, an additional six smaller [[Seneschal's Chest]]s will spawn.

Afterward, the door to {{poi|Sylvan Cradle}} will open for access to:
* '''Achievement''' — {{achievement|Tread Lightly}}
* '''Mastery insight''' — {{map icon|masteryvoe}} [[Starlit Weald Insight: Cloister of Stars]]

Speak to [[PTM]] to be teleported back to {{waypoint|Priory Expedition Waypoint}}.
